summary: Stage A web audit for brief 3 (lower 48), read-only. The web app is California-shaped in five places: overview frame/wording, time zone, fire-record source (CAL FIRE), search (California Gazetteer) and official panels (Cal OES, NWS 'in California'). Biggest blockers: (1) every time is Pacific via lib/time.ts TZ (214 call sites, 43 files) and laWallToMs hard-codes PDT/PST offsets, so swapping the constant breaks timeline/chart ticks; no state or time_zone in any web type; (2) no clustering: 1,178 real 2026 lower-48 WFIGS fires (>=300 ac) injected into today's overview give one blob on phones and ~40 colliding labels on desktop; (3) CAL FIRE hard-wired as the only fire record issuer (89 code lines); (4) official panels outside CA say 'California only' or stay silent (NWS) and link Cal OES in Idaho. Proposed: one tz-parameterised formatter (tz required so typecheck finds every call; CA output identical), backend time_zone/state/record_* fields, two clustered MapLibre GeoJSON sources (active/other; built in, no dependency), cluster click capped at z8 below FOCUS_IN_ZOOM, zoom-stepped labels, list 'in this view' with windowing, national search parsing, AK/HI 'not supported yet', UTM tests for zones 10-19. 418 CA-specific non-test lines counted (160 code, 197 comments, 61 fixture/dev). 5 user questions with recommendations.

notes_for_integrator: Planner: CONTRACT §14 should add IncidentSummary.state (USPS), time_zone (IANA), record_source/record_agency/record_url, uid (calfire_uid kept as deprecated alias), manifest.time_zone/state, time_zone + states[] on official/extras envelopes, live status detections_24h (keep detections_24h_ca one release); SPEC §4.2 to 'each fire's local time with its zone abbreviation'. Keep existing California ids (e.g. 2025-eaton-fire-dbfa57) resolving.

Time formatter: make tz a required parameter in lib/time.ts so typecheck enumerates all 214 call sites; replace laWallToMs's fixed 420/480-minute candidates with a generic offset search; CA fires pass America/Los_Angeles so all CA strings/tests stay identical.

Clustering: two clustered GeoJSON sources (active/other); hidden fires (replay, open fire) must be removed from the data before setData because layer filters do not change cluster counts; cap cluster-click zoom at 8 (< FOCUS_IN_ZOOM 8.5).
